segments.contextAfter: With [`fixedSize`](realityviewlayoutoption/fixedsize.md), the [`RealityView`](realityview.md) calculates the visual bounds of all the entities you add in the `make` closure, and creates a frame that tightly wraps that content.

segments.source: With [`fixedSize`](realityviewlayoutoption/fixedsize.md), the [`RealityView`](realityview.md) calculates the visual bounds of all the entities you add in the `make` closure, and creates a frame that tightly wraps that content.
segments.normalizedSource: With [`fixedSize`](realityviewlayoutoption/fixedsize.md), the [`RealityView`](realityview.md) calculates the visual bounds of all the entities you add in the `make` closure, and creates a frame that tightly wraps that content.
segments.contextAfter: This is especially useful when you display a [`RealityView`](realityview.md) alongside other SwiftUI views because the frame accurately represents the size of the 3D content.
